name: Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth
summary: Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth is the supreme commander of the Stormwind Fleet, standing guard within the royal court. Stationed inside Stormwind Keep near the young king and his advisors, she oversees the kingdom's naval strength and maritime interests across the Alliance.

sections.title: Commander of the Fleet
sections.body: Standing within the grand halls of Stormwind Keep, Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth represents the naval might of Stormwind. Following the loss of Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore at Theramore, high naval command fell to leadership within Stormwind itself. Jes-Tereth maintains a watchful presence at court, coordinating closely with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and the Council of Nobles to secure sea lanes, guard the southern coasts, and project the kingdom's military power beyond its borders.

sections.title: A Fleet at Anchor
sections.body: While Stormwind faces internal crises—from missing King Varian Wrynn to unrest in Westfall and the Blackrock clan pressing in Redridge—naval defense remains vital. Jes-Tereth advises the regency on coastlines and ports, ensuring that whatever troubles beset the land, the kingdom's trade routes and seafaring forces remain vigilant against outside threats.

faq.answer: She is the high commander of the Stormwind Fleet and heads the maritime forces of the Alliance from her post in Stormwind Keep.

faq.q: Where can Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth be found?
faq.answer: She stands in the royal throne room of Stormwind Keep, positioned near the throne of boy-king Anduin Wrynn and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind need a Grand Admiral in the throne room?
aliases: why is jes tereth in stormwind keep
faq.answer: As the supreme commander of the kingdom's navy, she attends court to advise Regent Lord Bolvar Fordragon and the boy-king on sea defense, shipping corridors, and coastal security while King Varian remains missing.

faq.q: Who commanded the Alliance fleet before her?
aliases: who was admiral before jes tereth
faq.answer: Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore of Kul Tiras led the Alliance naval forces throughout the Second and Third Wars until his demise on the shores of Kalimdor.

angles.text: Jes-Tereth represents the sea power defending Alliance shores and maintaining supply routes between the Eastern Kingdoms and distant harbors.
For humans of Stormwind, Jes-Tereth is a reassuring sign of coastal strength even as land armies are stretched thin by internal rebellions.
